summary: As of 2026-09-12, Canada's GDP was USD 2,319,899,772,425.92 in 2025, GDP per capita was USD 55,697.664 in 2025, inflation was 2.0723% in 2025, the 10-year bond yield was 3.42% on 2026-06-01, and the CAD/USD exchange rate was 0.721033 USD per 1 CAD with a -0.243% change. The 10-year bond yield history covers 2016-2026, moving from 1.2518% in 2016 to 3.4353% in 2026, while FX history is available only from 2020 to 2026, moving from 0.764993 in 2020 to 0.722699 in 2026.
